title: Designing Your Life: The Four Essential Questions
summary: Reflecting on ongoing district interviews, President Hughes challenges missionaries to consciously design their future lives rather than living by default. He breaks down four pivotal questions—What do I want to be?, Why do I want to be that?, What am I willing to sacrifice?, and How am I going to become it?—emphasizing that true fulfillment begins with internal character ('being') rather than external acquisitions ('having'). Scriptural examples like King Lamoni's father illustrate that sacrifice is actually an investment in a higher-value future.
